from pathlib import Path
import json
import imageio.v2 as imageio
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
import numpy as np
import torch
from hexapod_transport_rl import PosePushConfig, PosePushEnv

root = Path('/home/hashimoto/2026/10/hexapod_transport_rl')
torch.set_num_threads(1)
configs = []
for n in (2, 3, 4):
    cfg = PosePushConfig(num_robots=n)
    env = PosePushEnv(cfg, render_mode='rgb_array', width=960, height=720)
    obs, info = env.reset(options={'randomize': False})
    if n == 2:
        imageio.imwrite(root/'docs/figures/goal_side_start.png', env.render())
    positions = env.core.robot_xy.copy()
    configs.append({'num_robots': n, 'bar_length_m': cfg.width, 'stem_length_m': cfg.t_stem_length,
                    'cargo_junction_xy': env.core.cargo_xy.tolist(), 'goal_junction_xy': env.core.goal.tolist(),
                    'robot_xy': positions.tolist(), 'robot_yaw': env.core.yaw(env.core.base_ids).tolist(),
                    'episode_seconds': cfg.episode_seconds, 'initial_ncon': env.core.data.ncon})
    env.close()

cfg = PosePushConfig()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((-cfg.width/2, -.1), cfg.width, .2, facecolor='#e5a626'))
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((-.1, -.1), .2, -(cfg.t_stem_length-.1), facecolor='#e5a626'))
ax.scatter([0], [0], color='#343a40', s=25, zorder=5)
ax.annotate('', xy=(-.65, .22), xytext=(.65, .22), arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'<->'})
ax.text(0, .29, 'Crossbar: 1.30 m', ha='center')
ax.annotate('', xy=(.25, 0), xytext=(.25, -1.3), arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'<->'})
ax.text(.31, -.65, 'Stem: 1.30 m', rotation=90, va='center')
ax.text(-.16, -.65, 'Thickness: 0.20 m', ha='right')
ax.set(xlim=(-.9, .9), ylim=(-1.48, .55), aspect='equal')
ax.axis('off')
fig.tight_layout()
fig.savefig(root/'docs/figures/equal_bar_t.png', dpi=160)
plt.close(fig)
(root/'docs/results/goal_side_reset_20261008.json').write_text(json.dumps({'description':'New untrained task: equal crossbar/stem centerline lengths; T -> goal -> robots, all robots face toward the cargo. Existing successful videos use the earlier equal-arm rear-start task.', 'initial_cases':configs},indent=2)+'\n')
print(configs)
